title: AI agents can coordinate beyond human scale

live_model.evidence: GPT-4 Turbo gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 (Table 1, Methods); 'In all the simulations reported in the main text we used T = 0.2'

prompt.location: Methods, 'Opinion dynamics simulations' (prompt block with friend list and bracketed reply)
prompt.note: Opinion names are random letters/strings shuffled each iteration; the simulation loop is given as steps 1-4.

claim.metric: coordination level C at t=10 for N=50 agents (fraction of realizations reaching C=1)
claim.location: Figure 2 and Results text: 'Claude 3 Opus and GPT-4 Turbo, coordinate in all simulations' (20 realizations)

notes: Each realization needs up to N x t = 500 model calls (fewer if coordination is reached early); 20 realizations x 3 seeds ~ 30k short calls. Cheaper secondary check: Table 3 majority-counting success 0.735 at N=51 (trial count not stated).
